messages.content: I need all pending and active mandates of users parath and bhanu

function.name: user_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a user based on the provided user name and the status of the mandates. This API is intended for use by partners to retrieve information about their clients' mandates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The full name of the partner's client for whom to fetch mandates.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched.

function.name: partner_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a partner based on the specified status. If no status is provided, all mandates are retrieved. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched. If left empty, mandates with any status will be retrieved.

message.reasoning:
We need to call user_mandates twice: once for parath, once for bhanu. The user wants all pending and active mandates. The function signature allows specifying status: "active" | "pending" | "inactive". It says default: active. But we want both pending and active. There's no option to get multiple statuses at once. So we need to call twice per user? Actually we can call user_mandates twice per user: one with status "active", one with status "pending". Then combine results. Or maybe we can call partner_mandates? That fetches mandates for partner. But we need specific users. So use user_mandates.

Thus we need to call user_mandates twice for each user. We can do separate calls or combine? The function only accepts one status. So we need two calls per user. Let's do that. We'll call user_mandates({"name":"parath","status":"active"}) and user_mandates({"name":"parath","status":"pending"}). Similarly for bhanu. Then combine results. We'll output combined list.
